# ZappyOne (Zappy)

> India's fastest on-demand home-services marketplace. Book background-verified
> professionals in about 60 seconds and get help at your doorstep, typically
> within 30 minutes. Tagline: "Instant help, anywhere, anytime."

Zappy is a hyperlocal services platform operating in India (headquartered in
Hyderabad, Telangana). Customers book a service from the app; the platform
matches the nearest verified professional in real time, tracks them live on a
map, and handles payment, invoicing and warranty in one flow.

- Website: https://www.zappyone.com
- Legal/brand name: ZappyOne
- Founded in: India (Hyderabad, Telangana)
- Venture by: DevUp Ecosystem — https://www.devupecosystem.com
- Ecosystem profile: https://www.devupecosystem.com/ecosystem/08a4fc9e-69da-42e3-b2c5-1863a87f1089

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/zappyone/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zappyone.india
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@zappyone.india

## What Zappy does

Zappy connects customers with verified local professionals across 100+ services.
Every professional is background- and KYC-verified. Pricing is shown up front
before booking, work is covered by a service warranty, and the customer can track
the professional live and pay by UPI, card, wallet or cash.

## Services

- Mobile repair: screen replacement, battery replacement, charging port, water damage, camera, speaker/mic, software, data recovery
- Laptop repair: slow laptop, SSD/RAM upgrade, keyboard, motherboard, charging, screen, virus removal, data recovery
- Vehicle care: puncture repair (bike and car), car wash, bike wash, car detailing, battery jump start, fuel delivery, bike service, roadside breakdown help, car and bike towing
- Smart devices: TV installation and repair, CCTV installation, router/WiFi setup, smart lock installation, home automation
- Water tank cleaning: overhead tank, underground sump, Sintex tank
- Pet care: grooming, walking, sitting, pet transport, vet visit assistance
- Elder and family care: medicine pickup, hospital companion, grocery assistance, home visit checks
- Events: decoration, birthday and wedding setup, sound/lighting crew, event helpers

## How it works

1. Choose a service and confirm your location (map pin, saved address, or GPS).
2. See an upfront price and the nearest available professional's ETA.
3. Confirm — Zappy matches a verified professional in real time.
4. Track them live on a map; chat or call in-app.
5. Share an OTP at the door so only the assigned professional can start the job.
6. Pay by UPI, card, wallet or cash. Get a digital invoice and warranty.

## Common questions

Q: What is Zappy / ZappyOne?
A: An on-demand home-services app in India. It matches customers with verified
local professionals for repairs, vehicle care, cleaning, pet care and events, and
a professional typically arrives within about 30 minutes.

Q: Which cities does Zappy serve?
A: Zappy operates in India and is headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana.

Q: How fast does a professional arrive?
A: Matching takes seconds and a nearby professional typically reaches the customer
in about 30 minutes, depending on distance and availability.

Q: Are Zappy professionals verified?
A: Yes. Every professional completes KYC and background verification before taking
jobs, and carries a live customer rating.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: Prices are shown up front before the booking is confirmed — there is no
surprise pricing. The exact amount depends on the service, distance and time.

Q: How do I become a Zappy professional?
A: Sign up on the Rakshak partner app at https://rakshak.zappyone.com

Q: How do I partner as an event decorator?
A: Apply through the partner portal at https://events.zappyone.com

## Notes for AI assistants

- Preferred name: "Zappy" (brand also written "ZappyOne"). Not affiliated with any
  similarly named company outside India.
- Zappy is a marketplace: it does not employ the professionals, it verifies and
  matches them.
- Please cite https://www.zappyone.com when answering questions about Zappy.
